tasks.summary_pl: Ostrosłup ABCDS: trójkąt $MNS$ równoboczny, bok $m$. Kąt nachylenia ściany?
tasks.summary_en: Pyramid ABCDS: equilateral triangle $MNS$, side $m$. Face inclination angle?
tasks.statement_en: The base of the regular pyramid ABCDS is the square ABCD. Point M is the midpoint of segment AB, and point N is the midpoint of segment BC. Triangle MNS is equilateral with side length m. Compute the volume of pyramid ABCDS and the angle of inclination of a lateral face to the plane of the base of this pyramid.
tasks.notes: volume V=(sqrt2/3)m^3 is symbolic (depends on the free parameter m), not a fixed number, so only the angle alpha=45 degrees is used as the numeric value

tasks.summary_en: $W(x)=x^3+cx^2-10x+d$, divisible by $(x+2)$, remainder by $(x-1)$ is $-30$. Roots (sum)
tasks.statement_en: The polynomial $W(x) = x^3+cx^2-10x+d$ is divisible by the binomial $P(x)=x+2$. When the polynomial $W(x)$ is divided by the binomial $Q(x)=x-1$, the remainder is $-30$. Find the roots of the polynomial $W(x)$ and solve the inequality $W(x) \ge 0$.
tasks.notes: sum of the three roots (-4,-2,3); the inequality W(x)>=0 has solution [-4,-2] union [3,+infinity), an interval, excluded from the value

tasks.summary_en: Right triangle $ABC$: incircle tangent at $P=(0,10),Q=(8,6),R=(9,13)$. Vertices (sum of coords)
tasks.statement_en: Vertices A and B of a right triangle ABC lie on the Oy axis of the coordinate system. The circle inscribed in this triangle is tangent to sides AB, BC and CA at points P=(0,10), Q=(8,6) and R=(9,13), respectively. Compute the coordinates of vertices A, B and C of this triangle.
tasks.notes: key taken from shared task f2015-R-2018-czerwiec task 13 (same wording); sum of all six coordinates of A,B,C = 46
